name: Impact Tremor
description: Short controlled camera tremor for beat hits, impacts, title landings, and energetic cuts.
author: ozonerepublic74d77777

parameters.name: Amplitude
parameters.description: Sets the maximum positional displacement in pixels.

parameters.name: Frequency
parameters.description: Sets how often the tremor envelope repeats per second.

parameters.name: Rotation
parameters.description: Adds rotational camera movement in radians.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Adds a small push-in or pull-out during the tremor.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how quickly each tremor settles after its peak.

parameters.name: Pattern Seed
parameters.description: Changes the deterministic movement pattern without changing its strength.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Blends the displaced frame with the original frame.
